item.title: Unicorn thinking
item.description: Magical thinking and the limits of US military power. This is the state of the so-called negotiations to end the US-Israeli war against Iran, which is in no mood to compromise – nor should it. CrossTalking with Maral Karimi, Helyeh Doutaghi, and Kevork Almassian.

item.title: Seeking peace?
item.description: The war continues. Tehran says no surrender to the US and that diplomacy is wiser than war. At the same time, Trump threatens to renew hostilities. It is difficult to say whether any real diplomacy is in play. Meanwhile, the global economy is being hammered. CrossTalking with Joshua Landis, Ethan Levins, and Hannan Hussain.

item.title: State of pause?
item.description: Donald Trump says he has postponed a planned attack on Iran at the request of Qatar, Saudi Arabia and the United Arab Emirates. Does this mean real negotiations and diplomacy are being taken seriously? Or does this mean Trump has no idea how to end a war he started? CrossTalking with Marwa Osman, Ali Alizadeh, and Haytham Faraj.

item.title: CrossTalk Bullhorns: Dire Strait
item.description: Has the American-Israeli war on Iran become a quagmire? As time passes, it certainly appears so. Also, as Europe prepares for a war on Russia, Moscow reevaluates its view of Europe, in particular Germany. CrossTalking with Mark Sleboda and George Szamuely.

item.title: CrossTalk Bullhorns: Thucydides summit
item.description: In a word, the Trump-Xi summit was a nothing-burger. It was an historic visit that will be quickly forgotten. What will be remembered is China’s Thucydides Trap warning. Also, how has security in the Persian Gulf changed since the war of choice against Iran? CrossTalking with Mark Sleboda and George Szamuely.

item.title: Peace without peace
item.description: Wars are easy to start but very difficult to end. Donald Trump is learning this the hard way. The American president is clearly looking for an exit from this conflict. His partner in this war is Israel. Israel has very different ideas. CrossTalking with Raed Jarrar, Elijah J. Magnier, and Hamidreza Gholamzadeh.

item.title: CrossTalk Bullhorns: Drone wars
item.description: Up the escalation ladder: Will the presence of Ukrainian drones in the skies over the Baltic States bring about a direct Russia-NATO conflict? We should all be worried. Also, will the fiasco now known as the Iran War find its final destination in Cuba. CrossTalking with George Szamuely and Mark Sleboda.
